adapter_warnings: Model 03 produces a conditional parameterised SEI-growth estimate; it does not independently detect an SEI event.

model_output.interpretation: Conditional model estimate from supplied calibrated parameters and temperature history. It is not an independently detected SEI event.
required_validation: Calibrate parabolic_rate_ref_m2_s and activation_energy_J_mol for the target chemistry, cell design and ageing regime.
Validate initial thickness, effective SEI conductivity and capacity-per-volume mapping using independent characterisation.
Compare predicted thickness/capacity loss/resistance growth against suitable reference measurements across temperature and ageing conditions.
limitations: The parabolic law is a reduced-order approximation; real SEI growth may include reaction-limited, solvent-diffusion-limited and stress-coupled regimes.
No anode-potential dependence, electrolyte depletion, changing porosity, cracking or SEI repair is represented.
Capacity loss is a parameterised mapping from added SEI volume, not a direct electrochemical lithium balance.
Incremental I^2*Delta_R heat is not total SEI reaction heat and must not be double-counted with baseline ohmic heat.
Cell-average resistance/heat does not predict local hotspots.

note: Native Model 03 payload passed unchanged. Results are conditional on the supplied calibrated SEI parameters and temperature history.
